reply_text:
Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't pass it to Ruth or post it anywhere else, since you shared it with me in a direct message.

If Ruth needs to know about the Albany site, she's best briefed by you or Mateo. If you want help getting it to her, tell me what you'd like, such as a short note from you to Ruth, and I'll draft it for you to review before it goes anywhere. I can't put it in a channel or send it on your behalf without you asking me to.
